mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveWaitPsgList */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) AS HOUR, SUM(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS WAIT_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 -- LS 랜드사이드 좌석, CC 체크인카운터, CK 셀프체크인, SBD 셀프백드랍, LGT 출국장, LC 출국심사, SC 보안검색대, SR 보안검색대RED AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) ORDER BY HOUR

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltKpiRaw */ SELECT ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS AVG_WTNG_HR, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS P95_WTNG_HR, MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS MAX_WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item})
mapper.insert: /* CastSmltMapper.insertSmltExcnHstry */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY ( SMLT_ID, SMLT_EXCN_SN, TMNL_ID, SMLT_TYPE, SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD, SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{smltId}, #{smltExcnSn}, #{tmnlId}, #{smltType}, #{smltExcnSttsCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltExcnByKey */ SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_EXCN_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BGN_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '') AS END_DT FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.SMLT_EXCN_SN = #{smltExcnSn}

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltExcnList */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT DESC) AS ROW_NUM, A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_EXCN_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BGN_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '') AS END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, -- 사용자 테이블이 확인되지 않아 부서/성명은 아직 조인하지 못한다 (G1) '' AS DEPT_NM, '' AS USER_NM FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt} ORDER BY A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT DESC

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltExcnSmry */ -- 평균 수행시간은 완료 건만 센다. 진행중 건을 섞으면 종료일시가 없어 평균이 0 쪽으로 끌린다 SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DONE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RUNNING_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 86400 END )), 0) AS AVG_EXEC_SEC FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt}

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltExcnDetail */ -- 한 시뮬레이션이 여러 번 수행됐으면 가장 최근 수행 1건을 보여준다 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_EXCN_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BGN_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '') AS END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(B.EXCN_YMD, '') AS EXCN_YMD, -- 사용자 테이블이 확인되지 않아 부서/성명은 아직 조인하지 못한다 (G1) '' AS DEPT_NM, '' AS USER_NM FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG B ON A.SMLT_ID = B.SMLT_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} ORDER BY A.SMLT_EXCN_SN DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveLastSmltExcn */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_EXCN_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.SMLT_EXCN_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BGN_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_EXCN_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '') AS END_DT FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_EXCN_HSTRY A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} ORDER BY A.SMLT_EXCN_SN DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
